metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2025 · Wake Up Dead Man
metas.description: Detective Benoit Blanc teams up with an earnest young priest to investigate a perfectly impossible crime at a small-town church with a dark history.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2026 · The Rip
metas.description: A group of Miami cops discovers a stash of millions in cash, leading to distrust as outsiders learn about the huge seizure, making them question who to rely on.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2025 · The Thursday Murder Club
metas.description: Four irrepressible retirees spend their time solving cold case murders for fun, but their casual sleuthing takes a thrilling turn when they find themselves with a real whodunit on their hands.

metas.name: ★ 5.6 · 2025 · Havoc
metas.description: After a drug deal gone wrong, a bruised detective must fight his way through the criminal underworld to rescue a politician's estranged son, unraveling a deep web of corruption and conspiracy that ensnares his entire city.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2026 · The Whisper Man
metas.description: A grieving father and his young son relocate to the quiet town of Featherbank, which was terrorized by a serial killer known as The Whisper Man 15 years earlier, while rumors circulated that Whisper Man worked with an accomplice.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2025 · Den of Thieves: Pantera
metas.description: Big Nick is back on the hunt in Europe and closing in on Donnie, who is embroiled in the treacherous world of diamond thieves and the infamous Panther mafia, as they plot a massive heist of the world's largest diamond exchange.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2026 · Unabomber
metas.description: A Harvard student becomes the Unabomber after psychological experiments. Years later, an FBI agent's pursuit reveals how his past shaped his deadly campaign that killed 3 and injured 23 from 1978-1995.

metas.name: ★ 5.9 · 2025 · Ballad of a Small Player
metas.description: When his past and his debts start to catch up with him, a high-stakes gambler laying low in Macau encounters a kindred spirit who might just hold the key to his salvation.

metas.name: ★ 5.9 · 2025 · Night Always Comes
metas.description: Risking everything to secure a future for herself and her brother, Lynette sets out on a dangerous odyssey, confronting her own dark past over the course of one propulsive night.

metas.name: ★ 5.8 · 2025 · Jingle Bell Heist
metas.description: At the height of the holiday season, two strangers team up to rob one of London's most famous department stores while accidentally falling in love.

metas.name: ★ 5.7 · 2025 · iHostage
metas.description: When a gunman enters an Apple Store in the heart of Amsterdam, the police face a delicate challenge to resolve the standoff. Based on true events.

metas.name: ★ 5.9 · 2025 · Ad Vitam
metas.description: After escaping an attempted murder, Franck Lazareff must find his wife Leo, who has been kidnapped by a mysterious group of armed men. He is caught up by his past and plunged into a state affair that is beyond him.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2025 · Bullet Train Explosion
metas.description: A group who straps bombs to a Japanese bullet train in an attempt to extort money from the government.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2025 · A Widow's Game
metas.description: A murder mystery about a young widow who is the prime suspect in her husband's stabbing death.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2026 · Facing El Chapo
metas.description: Follows two cops who in a routine stop pull over a stolen car only to come face to face with one of the most dangerous criminals in the world.

metas.name: ★ 5.4 · 2025 · Demon City
metas.description: Framed for his family's murder and left for dead, an ex-hitman will stop at nothing to exact revenge on the masked "demons" who have taken over his city.

metas.name: ★ 6.0 · 2025 · Revelations
metas.description: A pastor and a detective, driven by their beliefs, pursue a missing person case, with the pastor seeking retribution after a divine revelation identifies the culprit who abducted his son.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2025 · My Father, the BTK Killer
metas.description: Family man and Scout leader Dennis Rader led a double life as BTK killer. His daughter Kerri Rawson shares her experience with her father's horrific crimes.

metas.name: ★ 6.1 · 2025 · Aileen: Queen of the Serial Killers
metas.description: Aileen Wuornos killed 7 men while working as a prostitute in Florida (1989-90), claiming self-defense against rape.

metas.name: ★ 5.5 · 2026 · The Investigation of Lucy Letby
metas.description: Unseen footage and unheard insider accounts reveal the harrowing and divisive Case of Lucy Letby, the neonatal nurse convicted of fatally harming infants.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2025 · Good News
metas.description: In the 1970s, a covert team is determined to land a hijacked plane by any means necessary.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2025 · Last Bullet
metas.description: In southern France, Lino is a getaway driver, ex-convict, and burglar who builds cars for criminal purposes.

metas.name: ★ 5.6 · 2025 · Squad 36
metas.description: Transferred to the Anti-Crime Brigade, a senior officer probes the deaths of two ex-colleagues and disappearance of another, exposing a bitter feud within the police force.
